newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arab League condemns U.S. attack against Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Arab League condemns U.S. attack against Iraq.

text.p: The Arab League on Tuesday condemned the U.S. attack on Iraq as infringing the sovereignty of an Arab country.
"The Arab League Secretary General, Esmat Abdel-Meguid, deeply renounced the attack, which does not rely upon any international legitimacy," the league said in a statement.
"It is thus considered an infringement of an Arab country's sovereignty... and an interference in its internal affairs."
The statement added the attack "also contradicts with rules of the international law."

The United States on Tuesday launched cruise missile strikes in retaliation for last weekend's Iraqi military attacks that supported a Kurdish faction in its fight against another Kurdish group in northern Iraq.
Meguid renewed his "keenness for Iraq's integrity and condemnation of foreign interfernces in north Iraq," the statement said.
"The use of military force will lead only to more aggravation in the situations and expose the region to factors of tension and instability," it added.
